explanation: Compared with Keusch (arXiv:2303.02611, abstract): for every graph without an isolated edge 'the edges can be assigned weights from {1,2,3} so that no two neighbors receive the same sum of incident edge weights', solving the Karoński–Łuczak–Thomason conjecture. NoIsolatedEdge (no edge with both endpoints of degree 1, i.e. no K2 component), weightedDegree (sum over incident edges) and IsVertexColouringWeighting match; weights are constrained to {1,2,3} on edges (values off the edge set are irrelevant). Faithful.
